title: Generate Mermaid.js Diagrams with AL Code (2026 Edition)

chapters.title: New App Overview and Demo Setup

features.name: Mermaid Diagram Generation in AL
features.description: Library that renders Mermaid diagrams to SVGs within AL code, allowing diagrams to be generated and embedded directly without runtime browser rendering.

features.name: Interactive Diagram Elements
features.description: Ability to set click events on diagram elements and receive callbacks to AL code, enabling interactive UI where certain elements can be designated as clickable.
caveats: Click events must be configured explicitly

features.name: Multiple Diagram Types Support
features.description: Support for various diagram types including flowcharts, sequence diagrams, entity relationship diagrams, state diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, git graphs, mind maps, journey diagrams, and timelines.
caveats: Some diagram types have not been fully ported as they were not needed

features.name: CSS Theming Support
features.description: Diagrams can be themed with CSS, including support for dark mode rendering.

features.name: Fast Rendering Performance
features.description: Diagram rendering performance in AL code is very fast, with complex diagrams rendering in just a few milliseconds.
